name: Wellington Station
basis: The terminus of every line in the study area, and absent from the LINZ Topo50 station points (layer 50318), which carry every suburban station but not this one. Placed by hand at the station building on Bunny Street, approximate to about 100 m. Added so that Thorndon, Pipitea and the northern CBD are measured to the station beside them rather than to Crofton Downs, 2.9 km away.
